Image 1 is the front identity photograph of the exact white BMW X3 G01 facelift ordinary five-door SUV, representing the 2021–2024 family. Image 2 is the same N1L021 car photographed from behind 44 seconds later by the same author; use it only to confirm the roof fin, rails and complete rear wheel where the shelter pole obscures that wheel in Image 1. Both inputs are licensed published 1920-pixel derivatives, not master originals. Create a new coherent whole-vehicle catalog view with a balanced front three-quarter 1/2 camera and the nose pointing left. Show both headlamps, the entire kidney grille and front bumper and a substantial side. Rotate the whole vehicle consistently; never use the rear camera or rotate only the nose.

Retain the actual white gloss paint, white mirror caps with their black lower repeater strips, body-coloured handles, black raised longitudinal roof rails, and silver multi-petal alloy wheels with BMW centre roundels and complete tyres. Use the unobstructed same-car rear photograph to retain the actual rear tyre and wheel shape, without guessing from the pole-covered front photograph. Preserve the taller connected chrome kidney grille and its actual vertical bars, slim facelift headlamps with angular connected inner light shapes, ordinary angular black outer bumper inserts, black lower opening and silver lower trim. Retain manufacturer roundels. Do not substitute an M Sport bumper or pre-facelift round fog lamps, different catalogue wheels or paint, or the charging flap of the plug-in catalogue reference. The actual source is captioned xDrive20d, but no exact power, gearbox or manufacturing year is certified by the image.

Keep the complete compact body-white rear roof fin established in the same-car rear photograph, with its actual tip and base, plus the two black rails. Let its visible amount follow natural self-occlusion in the new front camera rather than copying its rear-view height. Do not turn the rails silver, add crossbars, a mast, a roof box or an unproven sunroof. Shelter beams and poles are background, never accessories.

Remove the recognisable shelter, blue wall, houses, people, other cars, paving and their identifiable reflected shapes from the body and glass. Keep the actual white colour and gloss finish, black trim and silver metal with simple soft studio highlights and an unobtrusive actual interior. Preserving identity and equipment does not mean copying the old environmental mapping. Clean dirt and minor surface blemishes without changing physical trim. Replace the registration with a blank neutral plate, retaining manufacturer emblems.

Return a true transparent RGBA PNG with the complete vehicle, tyres, mirrors, rails, fin and bumpers within generous transparent margins of at least 100 pixels on all sides including the bottom. There must be no floor, contact shadow, reflection below the vehicle, glow, halo, coloured fringe or detached alpha specks. Use a clean finely antialiased outline without cropping or stretching the car.
